ask: Build the machine-load brake as a standing part of claude-settings, on every device that installs it (Windows and Mac, no admin): at the moment a lane is about to start, the guard reads the machine's load once and sets how many lanes may run.
note: Rulings, Oct 21: every device that installs claude-settings, storage as well as CPU and memory; accurate; cheaper than the problem (no watcher, no timer, no per-tool-call reading, no log of its own). Oct 22: no lane count and no claude process count. Landed in #562 (main 1842e56): memory and disk as shares, CPU from a 200 ms sample, busy refuses background spawns and Workflows. Session question 3, Oct 22: it refused every lane (CPU 87-94%, 35 claude processes). Correction, Oct 22: the advisor's reason 'this app has no background setting, so left out means foreground' was a guess and false; the session read claude.exe 2.1.308.0, and every Agent lane in this app runs in the background. Advice taken: keep the behaviour, fix the reason. In #564 (CI running Oct 23): a left-out or false run_in_background passes busy; CPU counts only with memory over 75%; so in this app busy slows only Workflows and explicit background calls, and full (memory over 95% or little disk) stops every lane. Mac findings, Oct 22, checked at 1842e56: disk is read as a percent, so on the 926 GB disk busy fires under about 139 GB free (it held lanes at 119 GB); Mac CPU uses the load average, which read 100% busy during Spotlight indexing while top showed about half idle. Next: batch 1 of briefs/cleanup-goal-2-oct23.md (full text on c37): disk busy under the smaller of 10% of the disk and 15 GB free, full under the smaller of 5% and 5 GB (your ruling, Oct 23; big drives are no longer penalized, small ones keep a share); CPU from ticks 200 ms apart on Mac and Linux, like Windows. Mac finding, Oct 23: a banchi lane read 100% CPU busy while top showed 24% idle; likely the 200 ms sample caught a burst from the lane's own local CI. The Mac session hand-patched the live guard (uncommitted, in claude-settings-live-1842e567c28d) to sample 2 s; it then read about 14% busy against top's 27%. Your word, Oct 23: 2-second CPU sample on every platform; a 2 s pause per lane start only. In goal 2 batch 1. The Mac patch is lost when the live link moves (the reinstall after #564), and the Mac reads the load average again until batch 1 merges.
title: Machine-load brake: every session paces its lanes to the device's real load
why: Your idea, Oct 20, widened Oct 21: when the machine is loaded, sessions slow down; when it has room, more lanes can run. Incidents: the 15 spinning claude.exe workers of Oct 19, the q_max load report, and the Windows RAM climb to about 98% of Oct 21. Your caution, Oct 21: measuring and logging have cost more than the problem before.
